defects.detail: The member earlier_end_check reports namier:held_texts_person_name=0 and says the packet number/name searches reveal no later operative ending source for this member. The frozen member record specifically warns no personal name parsed from the order title, WPA summary or held text. This was an unperformed member name search, not a searched-and-zero-hit result. The generic statement that 302 orders lacked names does not identify this member as one of them.

rationale: After-reveal review of the exact genuine claim, not a new blind review. The date defect is absent: operative_clauses[0].first_end.date and whole_order_end.date both correctly say 1941-09-30. The complete [APP text](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/executive-order-8503-exemption-zebedee-lapelle-from-compulsory-retirement-for-age) and [GPO witness](jobs/photius-gpo-volumes/output/texts/EO_8503.txt), HathiTrust hvd.hl272k pp.131-132, agree on Zebedee LaPelle, the single exemption under section 204, the September 30, 1941 end, Roosevelt and signing August 3, 1940. PAGE_CHECKS.csv has an actual pass record confirming the number, dateline and signatory on p.132; its record resolves the OCR 19/40 artifact. I reverified every primary span and APP text hash and the raw capture SHA-256 through jobs/cotton-capture-custody/output/SOURCES.jsonl and captures/1f1143c6d1e084e6c035ba3d291d0a14a891ce29825dcb9714bd2ca2c018c2e0.bin. One own-term exemption supplies the complete operative inventory, with no independent report/payment/appointment command, savings or recurring obligation. Inclusive expiry and the disclosed exclusive alternative comply with the owner ruling; contingent accrued service consequences do not continue the exemption. The first-end theory itself is supported, and no held instrument establishes an earlier end. Nevertheless the second, separately recorded blind-review defect remains in this exact genuine claim: its member rationale presents the Namier zero as a member search result despite the frozen PACKET.json warning that no personal name was parsed. I cannot uphold an unsupported source-search reason merely because the own-term date is correct. The US Code number search also ends 2026-10-09; eCFR/CFR and held corpus coverage remain bounded and do not establish absence of unnamed statutes or an unknown separation event. Correction must expressly identify the unperformed name search and qualify the earlier-end check, or supply a separately documented member search. Original authentication remains outstanding; this is independent AI source review, never human certification. The preserved blind verifier report is a non-pass for the sealed blinded card; it is not claimed as a mechanical pass for this genuine card. The sealed BLIND_REVIEW_B.jsonl is unchanged.
